title: dtype 溢出：int8/uint8 回绕与 float64 上溢
expected_output:
int8 127 + 1 = -128
uint8 255 + 1 = 0
float64 overflow -> inf: True
code:
import numpy as np
a = np.array([127], dtype=np.int8)
a = a + 1
print("int8 127 + 1 =", int(a[0]))
u = np.array([255], dtype=np.uint8)
u = u + 1
print("uint8 255 + 1 =", int(u[0]))
big = np.float64(1.7e308) * 10
print("float64 overflow -> inf:", np.isinf(big))
